population.kidComparison: About 35.1 million people live in Ghana—roughly the population of a major world region.

geography.climate: Warm tropical climate year-round with distinct wet and dry seasons.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Ghana
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Ghana.

exploration.didYouKnow: Ghana is located in Western Africa and its capital city is Accra.
